name: com.hlight.resource-bag
description: Reusable cross-genre stackable-resource management primitive (currencies, boosters, consumables). Composable via SO-based rules.

samples.description: Minimal bag with two stackable resources (heart + coin). Add, spend, log.
Heart resource with PeriodicDeltaRule. MonoBehaviour driver calls bag.Tick.
Chest bundle resolves into multiple component resources via BundleResolveRule.
Player bag + Event bag. Custom rule queries locator for cross-bag buff.
Recommended pattern: ResourceDefinition<TKey> + enum-keyed call sites. Zero SO refs on MonoBehaviours.
